messages:
Lina: quick design review for Compliance > Storage & Audit — uploaded a screen grab.
Harpreet: saw it. main things: retention control placement, KMS phrasing, audit log labels.
Lina: retention dropdown sits under the fold on narrow view. propose moving it next to the region selector or show condensed inline value.
Jonah: agree. also the label 'Retention (days)' is vague. what about 'Auto-delete after'?
Kai: +1 to Auto-delete. helper copy could say 'Data will be permanently deleted after this period.' and a small 'Learn more' link.
Harpreet: KMS badge currently 'Customer key' — customers interpret that as us storing keys. Suggest 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)' and hover: 'You control the key; Redwood never has key material.'
Kai: also add screen reader text: 'Using customer-managed key; Redwood has no key access.'
Lina: audit log currently shows raw event ids like `kms.rotate` and `data.purge_triggered`. UX: show friendly titles in the table and keep raw ids in expandable details.
Jonah: backend already stores both, we just need a label map + fallback.
qa-bot: accessibility check: lock icon contrast 2.4:1 on light theme (fail). Recommend darker icon color or add text label.
Harpreet: keyboard order nit: tab should go toggle -> region -> retention -> KMS. current DOM is different, will need reorder.
Kai: retention change should trigger aria-live announcement so SR users hear the new value.
Lina: confirm modal copy: current 'Are you sure?' too weak. propose: 'Permanently delete data after [X days]? This cannot be undone.' include link to retention policy.
Jonah: will mock updated layout and text, will open tiny PR and include screenshots.
Harpreet: ping me for copy review. i'll run a quick accessibility pass once demo branch is up.
deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-10 04:00 UTC — add feature flag `compliance-redo` to the PR.
Lina: Filed follow-ups: TRACK-812 (retention UX) and TRACK-813 (kms wording + a11y). Tagging @Harpreet @Jonah @Kai for reviews. :thumbsup:
